// diagnostic

E0398

Bit arithmetic and power use named methods, not signs.

What

Bit arithmetic and power use named methods, not signs.

Why

`!` negates a Bool and `&`, `|` and `^` mark ownership; integer bits and powers use named methods.

Fix

Write `value.bit_not()` to flip integer bits; for an update, assign the method result back: `x = x.bit_and(m)`, `x = x.bit_or(m)` or `x = x.pow(n)`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0398: tests/ui/sigil_compound_update_retired.stderr.

Error [jet.BitArithmeticNeedsMethod]: `&=` is retired; assign the `bit_and` result back
  --> sigil_compound_update_retired.jet:3:11
    |
  3 |     flags &= 3
    |           ^^
 Why: Marks express ownership and outcomes; arithmetic uses named methods
 Fix: Write `x = x.bit_and(m)` in place of `x &= m`
